integrity: The proof uses exact polynomial identities and a quantile-defined probability model; no simulation or finite numerical experiment is used as evidence for the theorem. The accompanying checker uses exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result is population-level and does not derive the limiting rejection probability of the spacing-based test on the constructed alternatives.
Only the differential-extropy contrast is treated; cumulative residual and cumulative past extropy statistics are not analyzed.
The nonzero \(\mathcal X_{1,4}\) value shows that this family does not refute collection-level characterizations using multiple system sizes.
title: A one-parameter family of asymmetric blind alternatives for the \(\mathcal X_{1,3}\) extropy contrast
